categories.main_business_segments: HKEX operates primarily in four business segments: Cash (equity products and Stock Connect trading), Equity and Financial Derivatives (derivatives contracts including DWs, CBBCs, warrants, and stock options), Commodities (base and ferrous metals futures and options via the London Metal Exchange and Qianhai Mercantile Exchange), and Data & Connectivity (market data services, network and hosting services). It also manages Corporate Items including investment income and charitable activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: HKEX utilizes advanced trading, clearing, and settlement systems including the Orion Cash Platform and is developing the Orion Derivatives Platform to enhance trading and risk management capabilities. It employs electronic trading platforms for securities, derivatives, commodities, and OTC markets, and offers a web-based data marketplace. The Group invests in IT infrastructure upgrades and maintains robust cyber and operational risk management frameworks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HKEX serves a diverse customer base including institutional and retail investors, listed companies, clearing participants, and market makers. Its markets cater to equity investors, derivatives traders, commodities participants, and data consumers globally. It acts as a gateway connecting Mainland China investors with international markets and vice versa, supporting capital raising and trading activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: HKEX operates primarily in Hong Kong and the UK through its subsidiaries including the London Metal Exchange and LME Clear. It has expanded international engagement with offices planned in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and recognizes exchanges in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. It also operates a commodity trading platform in Mainland China (QME) and maintains strong connectivity with Mainland China markets via Stock Connect and Bond Connect.
categories.supply_chain_position: HKEX functions as a central market infrastructure provider, operating upstream and midstream in the financial market supply chain. It runs exchanges, clearing houses, and settlement systems, facilitating trading, clearing, and settlement services. It also provides market data and connectivity services, positioning itself as a critical intermediary between issuers, investors, and market participants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: HKEX's strategic priorities include enhancing China connectivity, expanding global and regional partnerships, improving market liquidity and competitiveness, and advancing technology infrastructure. It focuses on developing future-ready platforms (Orion Cash and Derivatives Platforms), expanding product ecosystems (ETFs, virtual asset products), and sustainability initiatives including climate-related disclosures and carbon neutrality. The Group also explores adjacent businesses such as index and data services.
categories.revenue_model: HKEX generates revenue primarily from trading fees, clearing and settlement fees, listing fees, market data fees, and net investment income from corporate and margin funds. It also earns income from hosting and network services, commodities trading fees via LME, and other sundry income. The Group distributes dividends to shareholders based on a target payout ratio of 90% of profit attributable to shareholders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HKEX is positioned as a leading international financial centre and a top global IPO venue, ranking fourth worldwide in IPO fundraising. It competes with other major global exchanges by leveraging its unique China gateway advantage, diverse product offerings, and technological innovation. Its ownership of the LME strengthens its position in global commodities markets. HKEX emphasizes market quality, regulatory standards, and sustainability to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: HKEX reported record revenue and profit in 2024, with total revenue and other income of HKD 22.4 billion (up 9%) and profit attributable to shareholders of HKD 13.1 billion (up 10%). Trading volumes and average daily turnover across cash, derivatives, commodities, and Stock Connect markets reached all-time highs. The Group maintains strong capital resources, low gearing, and a consistent dividend payout ratio of 90%. It continues to invest in technology and strategic initiatives to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HKEX offers a unique value proposition as a superconnector between Mainland China and global capital markets, providing access to a broad and diverse product ecosystem including equities, derivatives, commodities, ETFs, and virtual assets. It differentiates through advanced technology platforms, robust clearing and settlement infrastructure, regulatory leadership, and commitment to sustainability and ESG standards. Its strategic expansion into new markets and adjacent businesses enhances its competitive edge.
